company.shortDescription: Oncobox is low-cost personalized genetic profiling to help cancer doctors decide which of these drugs will be most effective to them.
company.description: OncoBox is cost-effective personalized genetic profiling to help doctors decide which drug to use in late-stage cancer patients. OncoBox analyzes the molecular characteristics of a particular tumor and calculates the probability of a positive effect using specific cancer drugs.

productsAndServices.description: A diagnostic platform that analyzes tumor DNA and RNA to predict the efficacy of over 170 targeted and immunotherapy drugs, providing personalized drug rankings for cancer treatment.
